subject.title: [Bug]: Discord sends failed during a full network outage are dropped on reconnect (send_attempt_started refuses replay, no reconcileUnknownSend)

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101024 be treated as the canonical fix for this issue, or should maintainers prefer/repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100997 instead?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same message-loss report, but one changes shared recovery-state semantics while the other adds a Discord-specific reconciliation path and plugin API context; that owner-boundary and duplicate-send-safety choice should be explicit before merge.

options.title: Use shared cleanup
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101024 as the canonical fix for provable connect-phase failures, then keep Discord idempotent reconciliation as follow-up for true unknown-send cases.

options.title: Repair Discord reconciliation
options.body: Continue https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100997 after narrowing ambiguous timeout handling and adding regression coverage, using adapter-owned evidence as the canonical path.

options.title: Require live outage proof first
options.body: Keep both branches paused until an exact-head Discord outage/reconnect transcript proves one queued delivery and no duplicate sends.

recommendation.title: Use shared cleanup
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101024 as the canonical fix for provable connect-phase failures, then keep Discord idempotent reconciliation as follow-up for true unknown-send cases.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans the shared recovery guard, Discord delivery behavior, and recent merged recovery work where he is the strongest history signal.
